title: Hotel de Russie vs Corinthia Rome: Courtyard or Quiet Street? (2026) | Suites With Keith
description: Hotel de Russie vs Corinthia Rome, compared by a travel advisor who visited both in October 2026: location and quiet, room sizes, spas, the feel of each, and who each one suits.

hero.alt: A Hotel de Russie suite terrace with boxwood planters, looking over Piazza del Popolo’s obelisk to the hills
A Corinthia Rome suite with double-height windows, a gilded mirror over the sofa and a marble table

sub: Two of the few central Rome hotels with a real spa. One is a Rocco Forte I loved, with a courtyard at its heart; the other is a brand-new showstopper on a quiet square across from parliament. Here is how I would choose.

choose.h3: If you want the courtyard and a pool
choose.lead: I loved it. The courtyard is the star, the renovated rooms are playful, and the spa has an indoor pool. You are between Piazza del Popolo and the Spanish Steps.
choose.alt: Hotel de Russie’s large courtyard, with white umbrellas over tables and flowering balconies

choose.h3: If you want quiet and space
choose.lead: Wow. A showstopper renovation, large rooms and a beautiful spa, on a safe, quiet square that is still in the middle of everything. Truly a game changer for Rome.
choose.alt: A Corinthia Rome suite living room with a white sofa, cognac leather accents and marble floors

band.h2: Is a courtyard enough calm, or do you want a quiet street as well?
paras: At Hotel de Russie, the calm is inside. The beautiful, large courtyard feels like an escape from the city around it, but step out the front door and you are in the crowds between Popolo and the Steps.

The Corinthia is across the street from parliament, so the area is incredibly safe and quiet while still being in the middle of everything. Add large rooms and a beautiful spa and it is in the conversation with the city’s classics.
If you want a classic with a garden at its heart and a pool downstairs, pick the de Russie. If you want quiet outside as well as in, and more room, pick the Corinthia.

guide.alt: A Corinthia Rome bedroom with a bronze canopy bed and a terrace draped in bougainvillea
paras: The Corinthia is on Piazza del Parlamento. It is central, walkable to everything, and quiet, which is rare in Rome.
Hotel de Russie is between Piazza del Popolo and the Spanish Steps, the golden triangle of Rome on foot. That also means a busy street out front. The courtyard is where you escape it.

guide.alt: A Corinthia Rome bathroom in onyx and marble, with a freestanding stone tub and a crystal chandelier
paras: Space is the story at the Corinthia. The rooms are large and tastefully appointed, with onyx and marble bathrooms. It is new, so categories and views vary. Book with someone who knows it, and I’ll steer you to the right one.
Hotel de Russie’s renovated rooms have the cutest ceilings, each one lemon or orange themed. I also saw a stunning suite with a terrace and fantastic views; ask me which one.

guide.alt: The indoor pool in the Hotel de Russie spa, tiled in blue mosaic under a starry ceiling
paras: Spas and pools are few in central Rome, and these are two of them. Hotel de Russie has a nice spa with an indoor pool, a real draw after a day on foot.
The Corinthia’s spa and public spaces are beautiful. If a spa is high on your list, both belong on it.

guide.alt: A Hotel de Russie room ceiling papered with lemons, pears and blossoms on a pale blue background
paras: Hotel de Russie is a garden retreat. Everyone gathers in the courtyard, and the rooms are playful and light.
The Corinthia is a grand new opening, and the renovation is a showstopper from the moment you walk in. I was blown away.

faq.q: Which is better, Hotel de Russie or the Corinthia?
faq.a: It depends on how much quiet you want. Hotel de Russie for the courtyard, the playful rooms and a spa with an indoor pool. The Corinthia for large rooms, a beautiful spa and a quiet, safe street in the middle of everything.
The Corinthia, across the street from parliament. At Hotel de Russie, you step out into the crowds between Popolo and the Steps.
The Corinthia. Its rooms are large, which is rare in central Rome. At Hotel de Russie, ask me about the suite with the views.
Hotel de Russie: its spa has an indoor pool, rare in the centro storico. The Corinthia has a beautiful spa.

faq.q: Which room should I book at each?
faq.a: At Hotel de Russie, ask me about the stunning suite with fantastic views. At the Corinthia, room categories and views vary because it is new, so tell me what matters and I’ll steer you to the right one.
